page.layout: One page of text, dedicatory epistle. Full-width title and dedication heads at top; below them one column of text with a large woodcut initial "A" at left, the text wrapping around it. Page number at bottom right. No margin notes. Digitiser banner at bottom right omitted.

main_text.head: ILLUSTRISSIMO ET CELSISSIMO PRINCIPI ET DOMINO, WVILHELMO VI HASSORUM LANDGRAVIO, PRINCIPI HIRSFELDIÆ, COMITI CATTIMELIBOCI, DIETZIÆ, ZIEGENHAYNÆ, NIDDÆ ET SCHAUMBURGI, &c.
DOMINO SUO CLEMENTISSIMO, GRATIAM ET PACEM à DOMINO.
main_text.p: ADThronum Illustr. Celsitudinis Tuæ depono Vindicias Veritatis Hebraicæ, Tabulis Originalibus Veteris Testamenti comprehensa. Argumentum summis Regibus & Principibus dignissimum, qui Divinæ Veritatis supremi constituti sunt à Deo Custodes & Vindices! Hinc Deut.17. v.18. Regem jussit descriptum Legis Divinæ librum penes se perpetuò habere, ut & ipsemet Veritatem ac Pietatem inde disceret, & earundem in Ecclesia Protectorem & Defensorem se agnosceret: hinc fortissimo Principi Josuæ, in ipsis Imperii ejus primordiis Liber Legis tàm accuratè Divinâ voce fuit commendatus, Josu.1. v.8: hinc pius Rex Josias tanto fervore Authenticum librum Legis, per Chilkiam in Templo repertum, excepit, 2.Reg.22: hinc denique in Regum solenni & publica

page.notes: The woodcut initial "A" is joined to the first word "ADThronum" as printed (presumably "AD Thronum"). Title lines are printed in spaced capitals; the heading levels are assigned by kind. The dedication text at the foot of the page is truncated by the scan's bottom edge reading "publica"; the rest is not shown. Some words in the body are heavily blurred: "Josu.1" is read as printed "Josu.1." with possible misreading of "Josuæ"; verify "Chilkiam" and "Deut.17" against the original. Signature ")(2" is the gathering mark.
